| # bds_isobus_txCallback_tpf {#bds_isobus_txcallback_tpf-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                    |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+

 

+---------------------------+------------------------------------+-----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Declaration               | Meaning                            | Parameter       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

| bds_isobus_txCallback_tpf | ISOBUS transmit callback function. | func_pf         | Pointer to a callback function of data type isobus_txCallback_tpf which is called before a new message will be sent. The execution time of the callback function should be short to be able to meet the time conditions within the ISOBUS stack.                                  |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 | The return value of the callback function defines the number of data bytes to which the application may reduce the actual size of the TX message. The return value ISOBUS_BYTES_ALL_DU32 (= 0xFFFFFFFF) sends the message with the whole length as defined within the TX databox. |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 | typedef uint32 (\*bds_isobus_txCallback_tpf) (void);                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 | Function must be coded within the application program.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                           |                                    |                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                           |                                    |                 | Optional a NULL pointer can be assigned to disable the callback function.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
